closed_causes: evaluation protocol mismatch as the main explanation

one_changed_factor.name: stateful
one_changed_factor.rationale: Official SILG model.multi creates its LSTM core only when --stateful is set. Every prior R0.1 command omitted the flag and every preserved recurrent-state norm was zero. Activate the official recurrent path without introducing a new architecture.

factor_routing_proof: --stateful appears in every seed training command
every checkpoint contains core.* LSTM weights
every seed diagnostic has recurrent_state_l2_after_mean greater than zero
required_artifacts: three checkpoints with actual frame count, bytes and SHA-256
per-seed peak RSS and training wall time
policy entropy, recurrent-state norms and episode termination statistics
raw install, patch, training, evaluation and qualification logs
pip freeze, file-size manifest and SHA-256 manifest
qualification: correct win rate greater than random
three-seed mean improves and minimum seed does not regress
failure_policy: If factor routing fails, repair only the routing and repeat this screening. If recurrent state is active but Correct remains incompetent, reject missing stateful core as the sole cause and issue the next single-factor contract unroll_length 20 to 80. Do not end with a negative result alone.
